name: Mist
summary: In Teldrassil's shaded boughs, Mist lies wounded and separated from her companion. She needs a safe path back to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak at a nearby moon well.

sections.title: A Wounded Companion
sections.body: A gray sabercat named Mist lies wounded among Teldrassil's undergrowth. Deep slashes mark her back and belly. Her blue eyes are bright, and she stays calm rather than acting like a feral beast. She looks to friendly travelers for guidance and protection.

sections.title: The Price of Ambush
sections.body: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak and Mist were patrolling near the Oracle Tree when witches ambushed them and drove them apart. Arynia believed her beloved companion had died. Grieving, she withdrew to a nearby moon well and hoped Mist had survived.

faq.answer: Mist is the loyal gray sabercat companion of Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak. She lies injured in Teldrassil's forests after an ambush separated her from Arynia.
Witches in Teldrassil's woods ambushed Mist and Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak, separating them and slashing Mist's back and belly.
Bring Mist safely to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak, who waits beside a moon well near the Oracle Tree.
Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak is a night elf Sentinel and Mist's companion. She waits at the moon well near the Oracle Tree.

faq.q: Why are night elf Sentinels bonded with sabercats?
faq.answer: For millennia, night elf Sentinels have fought beside Kalimdor's great cats. The sabercats serve as fierce partners in skirmishes, scouts among shadowed boughs, and trusted lifelong companions.

faq.q: Where is the Oracle Tree in relation to this rescue?
faq.answer: The Oracle Tree stands in northwestern Teldrassil. A nearby moon well provides holy waters, and Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak tends to her duties there.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know the bond between Sentinels and sabercats is central to your warfare and forest lore. Bringing Mist home honors that ancient companionship.
As a hunter, you recognize the fierce devotion and bright gaze in Mist's eyes. Her safe return to her companion is a matter of pride.
As an Alliance member, you can aid the Sentinels in Teldrassil and build goodwill between the young Alliance and the kaldorei who defend the world tree.
